description: The charms of the Hand. A token without a location may turn up anywhere; one with a location only where the campaign is. The Fussenbach charms lean on what is going on in the village.

fortune.name: Fortune
fortune.flavour: A bone charm, warm from a pocket.

ground.name: Ground
ground.flavour: A scrap of map, folded small.

tokens.name: Lucky Bone
tokens.effect: Reroll one Serious Injury roll.

tokens.name: Sigmar's Nod
tokens.effect: Reroll one Rout test.

tokens.name: Steady Hand
tokens.effect: Reroll one Exploration die.

tokens.name: Know the Streets
tokens.effect: Choose your deployment edge.

tokens.name: First Through the Door
tokens.effect: Win ties for first turn.

tokens.name: Hidden Path
tokens.effect: Move one deployed model up to 4" after both sides deploy.

tokens.name: Fence's Favour
tokens.effect: +1 to one Rarity roll.

tokens.name: Debt Called In
tokens.effect: One hired sword's upkeep waived this game.

tokens.name: Black Market
tokens.effect: One Rare item found automatically, once.

tokens.name: Whisper
tokens.effect: See the scenario's special rule a day early.

tokens.name: Scout's Word
tokens.effect: Learn which Ground token the rival brought.

tokens.name: Cold Reading
tokens.effect: Learn the next scenario before it is rolled.

tokens.name: Justinian’s Hammer-Mark
tokens.effect: Ignore the first Rout test you must take.

tokens.name: The Old Baron’s Coin
tokens.effect: Reroll one dice of your choice, once. It comes up cold.

tokens.name: Low-Tide Path
tokens.effect: Choose your deployment edge; the rival sets up first.

tokens.name: Kummerspeck Seal
tokens.effect: +2 to one Rarity roll. Do not ask whose seal is on the crate.

tokens.name: Whistleblower’s Letter
tokens.effect: Learn which Ground token the rival brought, and see the scenario’s special rule a day early.

tokens.name: Chattering Below
tokens.effect: Before deployment, name one building. Nobody may set up inside it.

tokens.name: Hauer’s Whistle
tokens.effect: Reroll one failed Leadership test. Half the Watch comes running; the right half.

tokens.name: Millwright’s Knot
tokens.effect: Reroll one failed Initiative test to climb, jump or keep your footing.

tokens.name: Bargeman’s Chart
tokens.effect: After both sides deploy, move one of your models up to 6" along your own table edge.

tokens.name: Reed-Bed Blind
tokens.effect: One model deployed in cover starts the game Hidden.

tokens.name: Miller’s Bridge
tokens.effect: Your models cross one water, gap or marsh feature as open ground this game.

tokens.name: Bargeman’s Tally
tokens.effect: Sell wyrdstone as if your warband were one size smaller, once. The bargeman does not count heads.

tokens.name: Chandler’s Credit
tokens.effect: Buy one Common item at half price, once. Paid for in candles nobody asked for.

tokens.name: Watchman’s Rota
tokens.effect: Learn the rival’s deployment edge before you choose yours.

curses.name: Hungover
curses.effect: Kept home the next night. One model misses turn one.

curses.name: Marked
curses.effect: An unflattering notice in the Town Cryer. Lose Renown.
curses.headline: {first} of {warband} Named in a Notice Pinned at the Gate; Denies Everything

curses.name: Wyrdstone Cough
curses.effect: Cosmetic. Fades in three nights. Feeds the Chronicle.
